Custom Coffee Bags MOQ 500 PCS: Complete B2B Buyer Guide 2025

Published June 2025 · 8 min read · By BestPackFactory

Choosing the right custom coffee bags is one of the most critical decisions for any B2B coffee brand, private label roaster, or retail buyer. This guide covers everything from material selection and valve types to MOQ considerations and print finishing — helping you make an informed purchasing decision at MOQ 500 PCS.

1. Why Custom Coffee Bags Matter for B2B Buyers

For wholesale coffee buyers and private label roasters, packaging is not just a container — it is a brand statement. Custom coffee bags with your logo, brand colors, and product information help you stand out in a crowded retail market. More importantly, the right material and sealing technology directly affects coffee freshness, shelf life, and ultimately customer satisfaction.

At BestPackFactory, we work with over 50,000 global brands to deliver custom coffee bags that balance aesthetics with function. Our MOQ starts at 500 PCS, making professional packaging accessible to growing brands and emerging roasters.

3. Coffee Bag Styles Available at MOQ 500 PCS

All the following styles are available with custom printing at MOQ 500 PCS from BestPackFactory:

  • Flat Bottom Coffee Bags: Best shelf presence. Stands upright without a display stand.
  • Side Gusset Coffee Bags: Traditional style, good for whole beans and ground coffee.
  • Stand Up Pouches (SUP): Versatile, most popular for private label coffee.
  • Quad Seal Coffee Bags: Premium look with four seal lines, ideal for specialty brands.
  • Pillow Bags: Cost-effective for bulk orders, commonly used for supermarket private label.

4. Valve Options: One-Way Degassing Valve

One of the most important features in a custom coffee bag is the one-way degassing valve. Freshly roasted coffee releases CO₂ continuously for days after roasting. Without a degassing valve, bags would inflate and burst. The valve allows gas to escape while preventing oxygen from entering — preserving freshness.

BestPackFactory supplies:

  • Standard 22mm one-way degassing valve (most common)
  • Adhesive-back or heat-sealed valve application
  • Optional screw cap spout for resealable pouches
  • Valve placement customization: front, back, or side gusset

5. Print Finishing Options

The surface finish of your custom coffee bags dramatically affects perceived quality and shelf appeal:

  • Matte Lamination: Premium, soft-touch feel. Popular for specialty and artisan coffee.
  • Gloss Lamination: Vibrant, shiny finish. Maximizes color saturation.
  • Soft-Touch Velvet: Ultra-premium. Used for high-end single-origin products.
  • Spot UV: Selective glossy coating on logo or key design elements.
  • Hot Foil Stamping: Gold, silver or holographic foil for luxury positioning.
